name: Eugene:RE cautious OTO-aware restoration v1
intent: Small pitch-layer body-presence tests. Preserve synthetic/uncanny identity; protect fixed OTO regions and keep extensions/consonants/events on independent routes.

oto_mask.note: If any alias marks material as fixed, that region is protected for the shared WAV.

B2.name: B2-gentle-body-presence
B2.description: Very gentle wide upper-mid presence test; no low-end filtering.
B2.reason: B2 median centroid ~443 Hz; the 500–2000 Hz band carries ~45.9% of energy while 2–5 kHz is only ~0.27%. Start with a restrained occupied-midrange lift, not high-frequency cuts.

F3.name: F3-micro-presence
F3.description: Lighter version of the B2 body-presence test.
F3.reason: F3 has a similar broad 300–400 Hz envelope hump, but more energy concentrated in 150–500 Hz (~79.3%); use a smaller lift.

G4.name: G4-neutral
G4.description: Neutral reference; G4 has a distinct higher spectral balance.
G4.reason: G4 has higher median centroid (~567 Hz) and ~0.76% energy in 2–5 kHz versus ~0.27–0.29% for B2/F3. Keep neutral until auditioned.

L.name: L-neutral-reference-F3
L.reason: L median F0 ~196 Hz, close to F3, but only six recordings; retain its own route and keep it neutral.

V.name: V-neutral-reference-F3
V.reason: V median F0 ~195 Hz, close to F3; small three-sample set and elevated flatness, so preserve until auditioned.

TH.name: TH-transient-preserve
TH.reason: TH has fricative aliases and a larger residual-energy fraction than the pitch layers; do not apply pitch-body EQ.

R_ENGLISH.name: R-English-neutral-reference-F3
R_ENGLISH.reason: R English median F0 ~195 Hz, close to F3, but it retains a separate phonetic route.

CONSONANT_RELEASES.reason: Higher spectral flatness/flux than pitch layers; avoid global smoothing, denoising or tonal-body EQ.

BONUS_PHONETIC_EXTRAS.reason: Non-lexical events have much higher residual energy and spectral flux; keep outside singing-vowel processing.

ROOT.reason: Root-level material is not automatically assumed to be phonetic voicebank content.
